subject: Literature
title: Jane Austen's Quiet Revolution
description: A quick win: understand Jane Austen's Quiet Revolution.

hook.text: Jane Austen published all her novels anonymously, credited only as 'By a Lady,' and died unknown to the wider public.

buildup.text: Her novels dissect class, money, and marriage with an irony so sharp it still cuts two centuries later.

discovery.text: Austen invented free indirect discourse in English fiction, letting readers hear characters' thoughts without quotation marks.

twist.text: Critics dismissed her as a writer of domestic romances for decades before scholars recognized her radical formal innovations.

climax.text: Austen proved that novels about women's lives were not minor literature but the foundation of the modern novel.

punchline.text: She revolutionized fiction without ever putting her name on it.

quiz.question: What narrative technique did Austen pioneer in English fiction?
